item.title: Every new car sold in the European Union must include a driver monitoring camera
Men's average testosterone levels have halved in last 50 years
item.description:
📝 Researchers looked at data on male testosterone levels from more than 100,000 men captured between 1972 and 2019. “We saw an over 50% decline in total testosterone over this time period,” he said. ”The relationship between male testosterone and health is two-way and complex.
